head.dispatch: G-273 R-1 (2026-10-04 15:0x, 用户裁定「授权合成 fixture」)
head.inputBasisStatement: 本件全部产物均为合成件，一切结论标注「合成输入基准」，不冒称真实数据评测（W2 整改）
head.determinism: pure functions of (seed, grid, declared parameter types); no clock, no RNG
head.zeroExecution: no Pro, no MCP, no tools/call, no GP invocation, no GIS write

measurementDomain.georefConvention: GeoTIFF ModelTiepoint(33922)(0,0)->upper-left + RasterPixelIsArea; ESRI ASCII xll/yll = lower-left (both written and re-parsed here)

head.honestyDiscipline: 全量 synthetic 标注；executableInputAvailable 仅在逐件参数全可承载时为 true

calibrationChoice.choiceBasis: G-273 R-1 授权逐件合成合格输入；采用「类型化输入池＋逐件参数映射」以让 53 件共用在案量测域（同 EPSG/同格网/同范围），避免 53×N 副本造成的不可核对与噪声；先例＝D-101 组复用（groups ts08/x1..x8）

head.crsDeviationDisclosed: vector pool carries planar metres inside a GeoJSON-shaped document (not RFC 7946 lon/lat) — labelled, single measurement domain preferred

frozenSurfacesUntouched.note: additive only; the 78 artefacts and every frozen member are untouched

attrs.whatItIs: attribute table whose id values overlap both vector pools

classes.format: GeoTIFF (baseline, little-endian, single strip, band-interleaved-by-pixel, int16, uncompressed, EPSG:32651)

classesAsc.format: ESRI ASCII grid (int class codes 1-4, NoData -9999)
classesAsc.whatItIs: lower-left origin grid on the same measurement domain

dem.format: GeoTIFF (baseline, little-endian, single strip, band-interleaved-by-pixel, int16, uncompressed, EPSG:32651)
dem.whatItIs: int16 DEM, 4x3 NoData hole at rows 20-23/cols 30-33

events.whatItIs: xy-event table with a time column (space-time / event-driven tools)

featuresJson.claimLimit: declared as a document carrier only; whether it satisfies the tool's expected JSON schema is NOT VERIFIED until Phase B

flowacc.format: GeoTIFF (baseline, little-endian, single strip, band-interleaved-by-pixel, int16, uncompressed, EPSG:32651)

flowdir.format: GeoTIFF (baseline, little-endian, single strip, band-interleaved-by-pixel, int16, uncompressed, EPSG:32651)

lines.format: GeoJSON (planar metres, EPSG:32651, closed rings; declared deviation: coordinates are projected, so the document is not RFC 7946-compliant — labelled, not hidden)

negative3band.format: GeoTIFF (3 bands, byte-identical copies of one band)
negative3band.whatItIs: multi-band control that reproduces the in-case ERROR 000864 face; declared NOT a qualifying input for single-band parameters

points.format: GeoJSON (planar metres, EPSG:32651, closed rings; declared deviation: coordinates are projected, so the document is not RFC 7946-compliant — labelled, not hidden)

polys_a.format: GeoJSON (planar metres, EPSG:32651, closed rings; declared deviation: coordinates are projected, so the document is not RFC 7946-compliant — labelled, not hidden)

polys_b.format: GeoJSON (planar metres, EPSG:32651, closed rings; declared deviation: coordinates are projected, so the document is not RFC 7946-compliant — labelled, not hidden)
polys_b.whatItIs: two polygon features, ids B1..B2 (overlay partner)

remap.whatItIs: VALUE remap table for Reclassify-family tools

slope.format: GeoTIFF (baseline, little-endian, single strip, band-interleaved-by-pixel, int16, uncompressed, EPSG:32651)
slope.whatItIs: int16 slope-like raster (derived from the same DEM formula)
